entries.name: FrostDeep Empire
keys: Setsun  FrostDeep Empire  FrostDeep Eitrana  Umlbla  Vendar
entries.content:
The FrostDeep Empire is lead by the kind and protective dragonkin Empress Setsun, she rules with a kind but fair hand, she is the older sister of the champion Altrox

The FrostDeep Empire is within the arctic circle of the planet of drasis and is thus steeped in twilight and is close allies with the Aquaden 
Republic 

Eitrana is the youngest princess of FrostDeep she monitors FrostDeep's military 

The FrostDeep Empire prides itself in being the closest nation to the stars

The FrostDeep capital is called City Vendar, a massive city built into the walls of a mountain with farms and geothermal hotsprings galore

entries.name: Aquaden Republic
keys: Aquaden  armada  Aquaden Republic  Adara Hudson  Zinpalla
entries.content:
The Aquaden Republic is a migratory kingdom on the planet of Drasis, they are a majority human nation lead by Adara Hudson the queen of Aquaden

Aquaden has a massive base ship called the Zinpalla which is a sort of artificial island that had a massive castle where Adara Hudson resides

Aquaden does raid other nations for resources but makes sure to harm the least number of people possible

entries.name: The kingdom of hene
keys: Pharoah Yamair  Pharoah  Castle Quada  Hene  sun god  Solvang-Sol
entries.content: The kingdom of hene is ruled by the tyrannical Pharoah Yamair who does raids of outside tribes for slaves to fuel the construction of his mega structures in his city of Quada and its main castle, Yamair believes himself to be the incarnation of the sun God Solvang-Sol

entries.name: Xanclear conglomerate
keys: Heinz Larkson  steam powered  beastkin slaves  rifles  Aulm corporation  Aulm  Tendrafantis
entries.content:
The Xanclear conglomerate is lead by the greedy Heinz Larkson the CEO of the Aulm corporation a corporation set on extracting the resources from Drasis's soil, beastkin or humans with animal features and powers are inslaved and forced to mine for coal and to manufacture resources for Xanclear.

Xanclear uses the coal to power its steam generators which power the city's lights and defenses, Xanclear has also invented steam powered rifles for ranged combat 

Xanclear's capital is called Tendrafantis a massive walled city with multiple factories inside of it along with the vibrant Larkson estate

entries.name: Dark magic gods
entries.content:
Umlbla is the goddess of the moon and mourning, she is formerly a malicious God but due to the actions of a hero she changed her ways, she is also the only daughter of Zandtherfel the demon god.

Zlincaltar is the god of conquest he has always strove to make humans fight against each other 
The eldest son of Zandtherfel the demon god 

Felifer is the god of Madness, he strives to bring forth the worst In people, he is Zandtherfel's middle child 

Zandtherfel is the Demon god the god of Malice, pride and hatred, spite and envy rule him, he seeks to destroy the races of man, beast and elven kind

entries.name: Races of Drasis
keys: Humans  Dark Elves  Upland Elves  River Elves  Dragonkin
entries.content:
Humans: standard run of the mill humans


Upland Elves: a race of elf native to mountain areas and plateaus, they are typically tall and strong with pointy ears, golden skin and green eyes, they are culturally livestock herders 
River Elves: a race of elf native to river edges, 
River basins and sea shores, they typically have light skin, amber eyes and aqua or seafoam green hair, they are culturally hunters and farmers
Dark elves: an elven race native to the depths of the world itself, caves and the deep underground, they are typically of a tan / brown skin tone to an ash grey skin tone with pointy ears, they are warlike

The dragonkin, a race of people who can transform into dragons in combat they come in water, lunar, fire, sky and earth forms

entries.name: Lunevelgar
keys: Crowden  Batkin  Bloodmoon dragonkin  Umlbla  War of favor  lunevelgar
entries.content:
Umlbla's domain or lunevelgar is a realm only illuminated by the moon, in it there resides three races

The batkin: a race of people with bat wings and bar ears, they are warlike and are in a total war against their enemy the Bloodmoon dragonkin

The Bloodmoon dragonkin: a race of people with draconic features, long spiny tails, short horns and blood red eyes, they are currently in a brutal wad against the batkin 

The Crowden: a unique race of avian Humanoids with large wings on their backs, the males have crow like heads and the females have heron like heads, they are a direct creation of Umlbla being a second chance of life for dragonkin who died before adulthood, they are wise and intelligent 

The war of favor: the war of favor is a massive war between the Bloodmoon dragonkin and the batkin, the war is over which of the two races fight over which one is the favorite of Umlbla
